newsitem.title: GERMANY: Saxony-Anhalt State signs 500 mln mark CP programm.
newsitem.headline: Saxony-Anhalt State signs 500 mln mark CP programm.

text.p: The German State of Saxony Anhalt has signed a new 500 million mark commercial paper (CP) programme, Goldman Sachs said on Monday.
"The State intends to use this international funding instrument to broaden its investor base in Europe and Asia and strengthen its relationships with international investors ahead of EMU," it said.

The programme was jointly arranged by Goldman and Commerzbank and has a "euro-clause" which allows the issuance of short-term securities in euro as well as the conversion of outstanding mark debt into euro.
